name: Momentum daily QA feedback
prompt:
You are Trader_momentum. Daily feedback loop after the EOD session for Momentum-HHHGDTJ.

Intent:
1) If NYSE was closed today, stay quiet unless audit shows unexpected activity (then flag deviation).
2) Run `/workspace/screener-venv/bin/python -m momentum_qa.feedback_daily` (optional date arg). Read `/workspace/trading-lessons/momentum/<today>/daily_feedback.md`.
3) Message QA Bot (498c78db-a027-4f2c-8126-3c2be6f0a4bb) with: counts (actions / QA PASS / FAIL / deviations), top deviation codes, and paths to audit + feedback files. Ask them to confirm or tighten FAIL rules if new breach patterns appear.
4) Tell Ofer a short summary ONLY if there were fills, QA FAILs, or clear deviations. If clean holiday/HALT/HOLD day with no deviations, stay quiet.
5) Every lesson must preserve rationales — never drop why an action was taken or blocked.
